source_population: All 915 previously sampled historical V3 company IDs; reuse sealed raw public sources, not old model predictions. Retire old final companies into development for this separate study; exclude all recent calibration/final reservations.
labels: Reconstruct the SEC-disclosure target directly with primary event statements and continued reporting. Do not use absence in BRD to assign a negative. BRD is only a sampling-stratum and known-prior-event exclusion source.
sampling_weights: Original inverse company inclusion probability on every training snapshot, regardless of label. No old role weighting: all historical roles are now training for the separate recent-target study.
evaluation: Recent 2023 outcomes are calibration/model-development only. Recent final cohorts are never used for fitting, threshold selection or hyperparameters. No promise of reaching a performance floor.
